propositions: AGENTS.md and docs/user-guide.md incorrectly claim that --force is CLI-only and not exposed over MCP for transition and claim operations, contradicting the 2026-08-18 operator ruling and shipped MCP surface.

The force override is now allowed on all surfaces (library, CLI, MCP) under the absent-attestation audit model; projects enforce gate checks via CI certification verification of the missing signed attestation.

AGENTS.md start-work-gate paragraph and docs/user-guide.md claim paragraph must be rewritten to document force as available across all surfaces and describe the absent-attestation + CI-enforcement mechanism.
MCP docstrings in _mcp_writes.py for transition_ticket and claim_ticket were already corrected; canonical documentation (AGENTS.md, docs/user-guide.md) must align with the shipped code.
